{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 (377 rows) is the only batch with source_tz='UTC'; its txn_ts values are UTC, while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. The silver step casts txn_ts as-is, so UTC rows land about 6 hours late. Batch 13's first row is 12:02 UTC, which is 06:02 Chicago, the same opening-hours start the Chicago batches show. The early-morning 'outside hours' rows on 01-18 are really evening transactions from 01-17, and they also sit under the wrong txn_date. Normalizing everything to Chicago local time fixes the time distribution and the date assignment.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH t AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM t;"}}
